affiliation_filters.py --input-biom '$input_biom' --input-fasta '$input_fasta'
--taxonomic-ranks $taxonomic_ranks
## FILTER PARAMETERS
#if $affiliation.affiliation_type == "FROGS_blast" #if $affiliation.min_blast_length --min-blast-length $affiliation.min_blast_length #end if #if $affiliation.max_blast_evalue --max-blast-evalue $affiliation.max_blast_evalue #end if #if $affiliation.min_blast_identity --min-blast-identity $affiliation.min_blast_identity #end if #if $affiliation.min_blast_coverage --min-blast-coverage $affiliation.min_blast_coverage #end if #if $affiliation.min_blast_subject_coverage --min-blast-subject-coverage $affiliation.min_blast_subject_coverage #end if #if $affiliation.max_blast_subject_coverage --max-blast-subject-coverage $affiliation.max_blast_subject_coverage #end if
#set $sep = ' ' #if $affiliation.keep_or_ignore.taxa_choice == "ignore" --ignore-blast-taxa #for $current in $affiliation.keep_or_ignore.taxon_ignored $sep'${current.ignore_blast_taxa}' #end for #end if #if $affiliation.keep_or_ignore.taxa_choice == "keep" --keep-blast-taxa #for $current in $affiliation.keep_or_ignore.taxon_kept $sep'${current.keep_blast_taxa}' #end for #end if

--output-biom '$output_biom' --impacted '$output_impacted' --impacted-multihit '$output_impacted_multihit' --html '$html'
